description: Land Acquisition - Thumbowila, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically detailing the acquisition of multiple land lots for creating a water reserve. It contains detailed descriptions of properties, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, and extents. The content focuses exclusively on land and property matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
